package displaytime // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/displaytime"

const MaxName = 64

var ErrTimezone = errors.New("choose a timezone such as UTC or America/Los_Angeles")

func ForgetMember(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, id int64) error

func ISO(value any) string

func Initialize(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error

func Parse(name string) (*time.Location, error)

func ParseForm(values url.Values) (string, error)

func Read(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, id int64) (string, error)

func RenderPreference(p Preference) (template.HTML, error)

func Save(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, statement string, id int64, name string) error

func Suggestions() []string

type Executor interface {
	ExecContext(context.Context, string, ...any) (sql.Result, error)
}

type Formatter struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func In(location *time.Location) Formatter

func New(name string) Formatter

func (f Formatter) Clock(value any) string

func (f Formatter) Date(value any) string

func (f Formatter) Format(value any, layout string) string

func (f Formatter) Funcs() template.FuncMap

func (f Formatter) Location() *time.Location

func (f Formatter) Name() string

func (f Formatter) Stamp(value any) string

type Preference struct{ Action, CSRF, CSRFField, Name, Error, Notice string }

type Templates struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func NewTemplates(source *template.Template, bind func(Formatter) template.FuncMap) (*Templates, error)

func (t *Templates) ExecuteTemplate(w io.Writer, zone, name string, value any) error

func (t *Templates) Has(name string) bool
